description: Single Schedule C plus $25,000 qualified tips — Schedule 1-A lowers taxable income before the QBI 20% cap (G7).
derivation: Profit $80,000. SE deduction = half of SE tax on 92.35% × 80,000. AGI is not reduced by tips (below-the-line). Line 13b = $25,000. Form 8995 line 11 taxable income before QBI = AGI − std $15,750 − 13b, so the 20% TI cap is $5,000 smaller than it would be without Schedule 1-A.
